summary: The Form 6-K filed by Lloyds Banking Group plc on 22 May 2026 discloses routine director/PDMR share transactions, including LTIP awards, dividend reinvestment share acquisitions, and option exercises. The LTIP awards to executive directors and new PDMRs are standard long-term incentive grants, with vesting schedules and holding periods, at a grant price of GBP 0.00. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. This is a routine foreign private issuer report on equity compensation transactions and should not be classified as a special situation.
